Templates provide guidance on tool orchestration, required variables, volumes, and dependencies for common use cases like resume screening, code analysis, data processing etc. For example, a resume screening template would specify: 1. Required volumes for storing resumes and results 2. Python packages needed (e.g., PyPDF2, spacy) 3. Sequence of sandbox operations: - Launch sandbox with specific memory/CPU requirements - Create directories for resumes and results - Push resume files to sandbox - Execute NLP processing commands - Pull results from sandbox - Clean up resources. Returns: JSON string containing:, success (bool): Whether template was added successfully, template_id (str): Unique ID of added template, message (str): Status message
